scenario: An international visa service compares two appointment-scheduling systems across large consulates, medium consulates, and micro-posts. Administrators prefer Scheduler A because its aggregate successful-booking rate is much higher.

data.description: Booking success by post size and scheduler.

question: (a) Which scheduler performs better in each post size? (b) If the global mix is 40% large, 35% medium, and 25% micro-posts, compute the corrected booking-success rate for each scheduler. (c) Which scheduler should be preferred?

ground_truth.explanation: Scheduler B is better in all three strata; Scheduler A's apparent advantage is due to assignment at easier large consulates.

naive_answer: Scheduler A is better because its overall booking rate is much higher.
naive_trap: Consulate mix drives the aggregate result.
